description.text: The fourth Sun & Moon set, released on 3 November 2017 with 124 cards: 111 and 13 secret rares, a smaller set after two very large ones. It brought the Ultra Beasts to the game as Pokémon-GX with a red GX, among them Nihilego-GX, Buzzwole-GX and Guzzlord-GX, whose GX attacks play with Prize cards, and it also centers on Silvally. It is almost exactly the Japanese sets Awakened Heroes and Ultradimensional Beasts, released on 15 September 2017, and its full-art Olivia, a Japanese promo, made its English debut here. Its theme decks are Destruction Fang and Clanging Thunder.
